commit_message:
[Flow] Fold chained tensor.slice ops (#24628)

This PR Adds a canonicalization pattern for `flow.tensor.slice` that
folds only when the producer of the slice source is also a
`flow.tensor.slice`.

**Example :**

%producer = flow.tensor.slice %src[producer_start for producer_length]
%consumer = flow.tensor.slice %producer[consumer_start for
consumer_length]

**Canonicalizes to :**

%consumer = flow.tensor.slice %src[producer_start + consumer_start ] for
consumer_length

Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@9c51ed38f1e2 (#24662)

Adapted compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/Common/FoldTensorExtractOp.td
to specify invariant argument to memref.load, required due to:
f9f52bbcbc55 [mlir][memref] Add invariant attribute to memref.load
(#206197)
    
Re-generating the CAPI export files was required due to:
9889e626983f [mlir-c] Add IRMapping C API bindings (#206146)

Setting the module's targget triple in ROCM target due to:
00a6186128d3 AMDGPU: Prefer getting the triple from the module over the
TargetMachine (#206055)

Finding the LLVM commits and adapting the IREE code has been assistend
by Claude Code. The changes have been reviewed manually.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[ROCM] Validate that target triple is set in module and test for it (#24663)

Since LLVM commit
00a6186128d3 AMDGPU: Prefer getting the triple from the module over the
TargetMachine (#206055) the target riple of the module has to be set.

There was a suggestion for a dedicated test in
https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/24662#discussion_r3512817954.

Add the check for the target triple to the ROCM module validation and
add a LIT test for it.

This change has been assisted by Claude Code. The changes have been
reviewed manually before opening the PR.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
